task_definition.task_name: Station Inventory and Event Catalog Plot on Custom Projection

task_description.overview: Render seismic station inventory and earthquake event catalog on a custom Albers Equal Area projection map.
steps: Configure an Albers Equal Area projection (central_longitude=35, central_latitude=50, standard_parallels=(40,42)).
Create a matplotlib figure and axis with the custom projection and set the map extent to (-15,75,15,80).
Add gridlines, coastlines, stock imagery, and political borders to the map.
Plot the inventory and the catalog objects onto the same figure without individual titles or colorbars.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismic station inventory from {inventory_file} and event catalog from {catalog_file}. Create a matplotlib figure with an Albers Equal Area projection using the parameters {projection_parameters} and map extent {map_extent}. Add gridlines, coastlines, stock imagery, and borders. Plot the inventory and catalog on the map in a single figure and display it. 
 Note: 1) Save the station inventory and event catalog plot to {result_plot}.
